messages.subject: Problem printing ggplot2 book
parts:
I just downloaded the book from http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/book/

I am able to print out almost the whole book, but there are two places
where Acrobat 7.0 (on Windows XP) seems to get hung up with a message
that says "flattening" and gives a percentage: pages 81-82 and
101-102. I'm not sure exactly which of those pages cause the problem.

I haven't tried it on another system to see whether it's reproduced,
but I'll try it on my Mac at home in Preview and see what happens.

Thanks for the book and I look forward to exploring ggplot2.
